cameraLog.title: Camera failure log
cameraLog.subtitle: Why the live view failed or recordings did not load. Only visible to you.
cameraLog.empty: No failures logged in this period.
cameraLog.legend: Stages: webrtc = low-latency live view (only works at home); hls / hls-master / hls-seg = live view over HTTPS, used when away; a 404 in hls-seg is usually the go2rtc session expiring due to a slow network or a background tab; snapshot = thumbnail; recordings = SD card listing. Failures repeated within a minute are grouped (repeatedBefore field). Kept for 14 days.

setup.title: Connect your devices
setup.install: Install Bitwarden on each device: <link>browser extension, mobile and desktop</link>.
setup.server: When signing in, choose Self-hosted and enter {url} as the server.
setup.login: Sign in with your email and master password. On mobile, enable Bitwarden as the autofill service.
setup.twoFactor: In the vault web app: Settings → Security → Two-step login. Enable an authenticator app and save the recovery code.
setup.import: Import what you already have: export your Chrome, Edge or Firefox passwords to CSV and upload them in Tools → Import data. Then delete the CSV and the passwords saved in the browser.

rules.title: Rules you cannot skip
rules.distinct: The master password must not be your Avyra password or any other site's.
rules.paper: Write the master password and the 2FA recovery code on paper and keep it somewhere physically safe.
rules.noRecovery: If you lose the master password, nobody can recover the vault: not you, not Avyra, not Bitwarden.
